title: KI Global Master's Scholarship
about: Karolinska Institutet's Global Master's Scholarship is for tuition-fee-paying students applying to KI master's programmes starting autumn 2027. Programme applications close 15 January 2027; the separate scholarship application runs 8-24 February 2027, with results on 26 April 2027.
requirements: Applied to a KI master's programme for autumn 2027 (University Admissions, by 15 January 2027) with a KI programme ranked first
Only admitted students are considered in the final selection
card_alt: Card for the KI Global Master's Scholarship at Karolinska Institutet, Stockholm, Sweden; deadline 24 Feb 2027. The photo shows an aerial view of Stockholm's Riddarholmen and Gamla Stan old town by the water.
